units.characteristics: whoredom as the faithless interior; judgment named in the children
units.gist: the wife of whoredom + the 3 children (Jezreel, No Mercy, Not My People) - 'the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the LORD'; unfaithfulness as the nation's inner condition, enacted and named

units.characteristics: the reversal of rejection; children of the living God
units.gist: 'in the place where it was said, you are not my people, it shall be said, children of the living God'; No-Mercy->Mercy, Not-My-People->My-People - rejection reversed by grace

units.characteristics: the heart chasing lovers, forgetting the Giver
units.gist: 'I will go after my lovers who give me my bread'; 'she did not know that it was I who gave her the grain'; 'she went after her lovers and forgot me' - desire misattributed, the Giver forgotten behind his gifts

units.characteristics: the wooing back; the restored covenant-knowledge
units.gist: GEM - 'I will allure her, bring her into the wilderness, speak tenderly'; a door of hope in the Valley of Achor; 'I will betroth you to me in righteousness, justice, steadfast love, mercy, faithfulness; and you shall KNOW the LORD'; from 'My Baal' to 'My Husband'

'love a woman who is an adulteress, even as the LORD loves Israel though they turn to other gods'; Hosea buys her back - love that pursues and purchases the unfaithful; 'they shall return and seek the LORD... in fear to his goodness'

units.characteristics: the three missing interior graces (faithfulness, chesed, knowledge of God)
units.gist: the LORD's controversy: 'there is no faithfulness or steadfast love, and no knowledge of God in the land'; the land mourns - the interior graces absent, the whole land languishing for it

units.characteristics: the lost knowledge of God; the whoring spirit; understanding taken by wine
units.gist: 'my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge... you have forgotten the law'; 'a spirit of whoredom has led them astray'; whoredom/wine take away the understanding; Ephraim joined to idols

units.characteristics: the God who withdraws until the heart seeks his face
units.gist: 'the spirit of whoredom is within them, they know not the LORD'; 'he has withdrawn from them'; 'I will return to my place until they acknowledge their guilt and SEEK MY FACE, and in distress earnestly seek me'
'come, let us return to the LORD; he has torn, he will heal us... on the third day he will raise us up' - a repentance that presumes on quick restoration, answered by 'your love is a morning cloud'

units.characteristics: evanescent love; what God desires (chesed and knowledge, not sacrifice)
units.gist: GEM - 'your love is like a morning cloud, the dew that goes early away'; 'I desire STEADFAST LOVE and not sacrifice, the KNOWLEDGE OF GOD rather than burnt offerings'; like Adam they transgressed the covenant

units.characteristics: the un-hearted cry; the half-baked, divided self
units.gist: GEM - hearts like an oven; 'Ephraim is a cake not turned' (half-baked); 'they do not cry to me FROM THE HEART, but they wail upon their beds'; 'they return, but not upward' - religion without the heart
'they sow the wind and reap the whirlwind'; made kings but not through me; idols of their own silver; 'Israel has FORGOTTEN HIS MAKER and built palaces' - autonomy that recoils

units.characteristics: becoming what you love (the formation-law); the coming exile
units.gist: GEM - 'they came to Baal-peor... and became DETESTABLE LIKE THE THING THEY LOVED' (the formation-law, w/ Ps 115:8); the days of punishment; 'I will love them no more'; the withdrawing God

units.characteristics: the false/divided heart; the summons to seek righteousness
units.gist: 'their heart is false; now they must bear their guilt'; 'sow for yourselves righteousness, reap steadfast love... it is TIME TO SEEK THE LORD'; 'you have trusted in your own way' - the divided heart summoned to sow righteousness

units.characteristics: the divine parental interior; the recoiling heart of compassion
units.gist: THE GEM - 'when Israel was a child, I loved him... I taught Ephraim to walk... cords of kindness, bands of love'; 'How can I give you up, Ephraim? My HEART RECOILS within me; my COMPASSION grows warm and tender'; God's inner conflict between wrath and love; 'I am God and not a man'

units.characteristics: return, hold fast to love and justice, wait for God
units.gist: Jacob who strove with God and wept and sought his favour; 'return, hold fast to LOVE and JUSTICE, and WAIT CONTINUALLY for your God' (12:6); the merchant who loves to oppress; 'I am rich, they cannot find iniquity in me' (self-justification)

units.characteristics: fullness that forgets; the ransom from Death
units.gist: 'when they had grazed, they became full... their heart was lifted up; therefore they FORGOT ME' (fullness->forgetting, w/ Deut 8, Ecc); 'I shall ransom them from Sheol... O Death, where are your plagues?'; but rebellion

units.characteristics: the true return; healed apostasy; freely loved
units.gist: GEM - 'RETURN, O Israel... TAKE WITH YOU WORDS... say, take away all iniquity'; 'I will HEAL their apostasy; I will LOVE THEM FREELY, for my anger has turned'; blossom like the lily; the wise understand these ways
